cards.effect: +2.5 effective power to your animal card after Inversion.

cards.effect: No gameplay effect. Consumed when played.

cards.effect: Leader-only (not Trick 1): if teammate matches suit and team wins, change Hunter next trick.
cards.effectFa: فقط آغازگر (نه تریک ۱): با حمایت هم‌تیمی و برد تیم، Hunter از تریک بعد عوض می‌شود
